digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, context-limit escalation and window sizing
propositions: For non-Anthropic-family models, models_at_or_above silently returns the entire ladder instead of locating the primary, causing escalation to propose smaller windows and different providers.

largest_window_tokens returns the ladder maximum instead of a conservative value for unlocated primaries, causing under-blocking in P8 size budgets and silent truncation rather than actionable _too_big findings.
The prerequisite-coverage escalation path exhibits the same downgrade-and-cross-family defect through models_at_or_above fallthrough and ladder[0] indexing, violating provider consistency.

The fix returns [model] from models_at_or_above for unlocated truthy primaries and min(ladder_windows) from largest_window_tokens, preserving single-criterion retry and enabling honest error reporting.
